scope: Current CarSim parameter/extrapolation model, offline retained native and VS/VSB evidence only; no physical safety certification.
time_convention: Cumulative and longest durations integrate left-held sample values to next timestamp; terminal endpoint adds no time. Native 0.0005s and direct VSB 0.01s remain distinct.
limitations: Pure-slip tire carpet row/column exposure from native alpha/kappa/Fz is a proxy; exact combined-slip internal carpet arguments are not reconstructed.
A stop table outside its narrow zero-force interval is not necessarily engaged; direct/reconstructed force engagement is reported separately.
Unmapped warnings retain the logged event only; no inferred duration or peak is assigned.
0.01s VSB lagged-slip/stop force statistics cannot certify unobserved between-sample peaks.
Native and VSB values at the same nominal timestamp differ beyond float32 roundoff; formula checks within VSB and cross-stream residuals are both retained, with no time shifts.
